root.label: Casts and cv-qualifiers
root.note: Qualifiers define access permissions while C++ casts constrain which type invariants you cross.

children.label: cv-qualifiers
children.note: const and volatile attach to types and distinguish object immutability from read-only views.

children.label: const object vs view
children.note: Modifying a const-defined object is UB, whereas const T& only restricts one access path.

children.label: mutable members
children.note: mutable permits updating internal caches or mutexes inside const member functions.

children.label: volatile semantics
children.note: volatile prevents compiler register caching for MMIO and signals without adding thread safety.

children.label: Qualification conversions
children.note: Multi-level pointers require outer const qualifiers whenever inner pointees gain const.

children.label: const T** rejection
children.note: Implicitly converting T** to const T** would allow storing a const pointer into a mutable pointer.

children.label: std::as_const
children.note: Adds const to an lvalue safely and deletes its rvalue overload to prevent dangling.

children.label: Named cast operators
children.note: Each named cast isolates a distinct operation so compilers catch unintended conversions.

children.label: static_cast
children.note: Performs compile-time checked conversions and adjusts base-derived offsets without RTTI.

children.label: const_cast
children.note: Adds or removes const or volatile, safe only when the underlying object is non-const.

children.label: dynamic_cast
children.note: Verifies polymorphic inheritance at runtime, returning nullptr or throwing std::bad_cast.

children.label: reinterpret_cast
children.note: Reinterprets pointer or integer bit patterns without adjusting class subobject offsets.

children.label: C-style cast hazards
children.note: C-style casts fall back silently to reinterpret_cast and bypass base-class access specifiers.

children.label: Incomplete type trap
children.note: Forward-declared classes turn a C-style cast from offset-adjusting to bitwise reinterpretation.

children.label: Private base bypass
children.note: Unlike static_cast, a C-style cast is allowed to cast to an inaccessible base class.

children.label: Strict aliasing and bit_cast
children.note: Object representations must be reinterpreted through safe copies rather than unrelated pointers.

children.label: Strict aliasing rule
children.note: Dereferencing an unrelated pointer type causes UB outside char, unsigned char, and std::byte.

children.label: std::bit_cast
children.note: Copies bytes into a fresh trivially copyable value in constexpr code with zero aliasing UB.

children.label: std::to_underlying
children.note: C++23 utility converting a scoped enum cleanly to its underlying integer type.
